name: compliance-theater-2000
description: Rich education compliance analysis support for Codex, including authenticated MCP access to policy, evidence, and compliance workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Compliance analysis and resources for education.
interface.longDescription: Rich education compliance analysis support for Codex, including authenticated MCP access to policy, evidence, and compliance workflows.
defaultPrompt: List Compliance Theater 2000's available tools and resources.
Load case file document id <case_id> and summarize it.

settings.name: targetServerUrl
settings.label: Target server URL
settings.description: Base URL for the upstream service or remote MCP endpoint.

settings.name: authorizationIssuer
settings.label: Authorization issuer
settings.description: OAuth issuer used to discover /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server metadata.

settings.name: clientId
settings.label: OAuth client ID
settings.description: OAuth public client identifier used for interactive login.

settings.name: clientSecret
settings.label: OAuth client secret
settings.description: Optional OAuth client secret for confidential clients.

settings.name: oauthScope
settings.label: OAuth scope
settings.description: Space-delimited scopes requested for resource and tool access.

settings.name: wrapUrl
settings.label: Session wrap URL
settings.description: Optional app endpoint that exchanges the Keycloak bearer token for an Auth.js session token.

settings.name: sessionStatusUrl
settings.label: Session status URL
settings.description: Optional app endpoint used to verify the wrapped Auth.js session. Leave blank to derive /api/auth/session from the target server URL.

settings.name: logFile
settings.label: Wrapper log file
settings.description: Optional path for MCP wrapper diagnostics. Defaults to ~/.codex/mcp-resource-auth/compliance-theater-wrapper.log.
